q: UniNest pe listing kaise verify hoti hai?
a: Hamare team ke members personally har property visit karte hain, documents check karte hain aur owner se milte hain. Tabhi listing platform par add hoti hai.

q: Kya UniNest par register karna free hai?
a: Haan, UniNest par register karna bilkul free hai. Aap free mein properties browse kar sakte hain, favorites save kar sakte hain aur roommate dhundh sakte hain.

q: Agar property mujhe pasand na aye to?
a: Aap hamesha dusri properties browse kar sakte hain. Hamare platform par 500+ verified listings hain. Humara customer support bhi 9AM-6PM available hai.
Generally 2 mahine ka rent security deposit hota hai. Yeh property owner ke mutabiq vary kar sakta hai. Har listing mein details mention hoti hain.
Roommate Finder page par jao, apna profile create karo with city, university, budget aur preferences. Phir compatible roommates ke profiles dekho aur connect karo.
Abhi payment seedha owner ko hoti hai. Hum sirf platform provide karte hain. Future mein online payment integration aa rahi hai.
